SOURCE INSTANCES

Tasks

Coverage describes the selected population. Converted tasks have passed format conversion, before curation admission. Training and evaluation use remain separate. Unique public inputs deduplicate instructions and public contracts across the selected sources; cells and columns need not add up.

Similarity is a retrieval score. A broad subject match can remain useful when the nearest capability is weak. Inspect instructions, descriptions and alternatives. Cutoffs change coverage; they do not change curation decisions.
